e3d88382-a2c4-4958-8311-f8bd9a3f1e21.title: Konjiki no Word Master: Yuusha Yonin ni Makikomareta Unique Cheat
e3d88382-a2c4-4958-8311-f8bd9a3f1e21.altTitle: The Golden Word Master: The Four Heroes and the Innocent Bystander with the Unique Cheat
e3d88382-a2c4-4958-8311-f8bd9a3f1e21.description:
In an RPG-like fantasy world consumed by warring nations and racial discrimination, the human kingdom summons five high school students from 21st-century Japan for assistance in their conflict with the demonkin. Now those students, with their experience of MMORPGs at their disposal, will hone their skills to protect the human kingdom of Edea.  
  
However, this isn't their story.  
  
Out of the five students, four of them were given the title of Hero and the fifth one the title of Innocent Bystander. He had been summoned by accident since he sat near the other four students. His name is Hiiro Okamura, an aloof bookworm with traveling and reading as his raison d'etre. Hiiro sees no reason to help the human kingdom in their offensive war with the demonkin, seeing that he isn't a Hero and that he has no real obligation to help them, and decides to leave the kingdom to go on his own adventure.  
  
Soon, Hiiro finds out that he has the very unique skill of Word Magic: magic that can materialize the definition of a word. As he travels more and more, he finds many uses for his Word Magic and many opportunities to find books, level up, and gain some of his own companions. Even with the outbreak of war on the horizon, Hiiro stays true to his desire to travel the new world he's in.

e10954eb-b0d3-4069-8679-b0e2d5d4fc31.description: Go Miso, a beautiful influencer admired by everyone. Paeng Miso, the girl who has always wanted to be like her. One fateful day, a strange being in a closed-down school bathroom offers a ten-day deal. Paeng Miso borrows Go Miso’s body—and steps into the world she’s always dreamed of. The lights, the applause, the love…all finally within reach. But as the days pass, desire turns into obsession. Paeng Miso begins searching for a way to keep living as Go Miso—no matter the cost. Because to have everything… she must give up everything.

171602df-9501-4cfa-9936-8cea6aaa3e58.description: In a world where dungeons have appeared and humans have gained magical powers, the amount of magic one is born with determines their strength. Amachi Kai, a weak conqueror with very little magical power, enters dungeons to earn money for the medical treatment of his sick younger sister, Nagi. But when Nagi’s condition suddenly worsens, Kai is faced with an impossible situation—he urgently needs a massive amount of money for her treatment. Driven into a corner, Kai recklessly joins an investigation into an unknown dungeon with an enormous reward at stake.

Little witch-girls Chocolat and Vanilla are best friends, but only one of them can be Queen of the Magic World. To determine who deserves the title, they must go to the Human World and enter a strange competition. Whoever attracts the most human boys wins! The girls had planned to be best friends forever, but both of them want to be Queen. Will their rivalry ruin their friendship?

5ecf58d2-fcac-44f1-8341-97b7ef4fe82e.altTitle: Even a Replica Can Fall in Love
5ecf58d2-fcac-44f1-8341-97b7ef4fe82e.description:
On days when she is sick, on days when she has a tedious day job, on days when she has regular tests.

On days when she is too lazy to go to school, I am called upon.
I am a convenient substitute for the body of a girl named Sunao Aikawa, and that is me.
I may look exactly the same, but my personality is a little different.
I can't go out freely, I can't even make plans for tomorrow,
I am a replica whose mission is to work for the original.
I was supposed to be a replica, but I fell in love.

A very pure and slightly mysterious "love story" that takes place in a town by the sea.

Jess Rabble, a mobile suit pilot, journalist and cameraman, wishes to photograph the truth of the world from a mobile suit's perspective.
